enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe in and out. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Keep eyes closed.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and morning hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Pick up face wash. Apply face wash. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Hang towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Open fridge. Take out milk. Take out eggs. Close fridge. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Take out plate. Close cupboard. Place bread on plate. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour eggs. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Open course materials. Read. Take notes. Highlight text. Open browser. Search for article. Read article. Write summary. Save document. Close laptop.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Get off bus. Walk to supermarket. Pick up basket. Walk to produce section. Select apples. Place in basket. Select bananas. Place in basket. Walk to dairy section. Select milk. Place in basket. Walk to checkout. Pay. Receive receipt. Walk out.

Enter kitchen. Place bags on counter. Open fridge. Take out milk. Place milk in fridge. Take out eggs. Place eggs in fridge. Close fridge. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Place bread in cupboard. Close cupboard. Take out apples. Place apples in fruit bowl. Take out bananas. Place bananas in fruit bowl. Fold bags. Put bags away.

Open fridge. Take out lettuce. Take out tomatoes. Take out cheese. Close fridge. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Close cupboard. Open drawer. Take out knife. Close drawer. Wash lettuce. Chop lettuce. Place lettuce on plate. Chop tomatoes. Place tomatoes on plate. Slice cheese. Place cheese on plate. Sit at table. Eat lunch.
